annual_gap_usage: Annual monitoring and annual feasibility only; never a short-horizon fallback.
partition_policy: Only candidates passing the unchanged three gates and having supported in-window realization enter the formal horizon ranking. Later realizations form a separate future_follow_up group; earlier and unknown realizations are separately disclosed, not scored as horizon money.
non_duplication_policy: Each source record ID occurs once per scenario; policy-linked client IDs are disjoint from client-only candidates. Do not sum estimates across scenarios or describe correlated forecasts as guaranteed income.
ranker_integration_status: Requires M4 v4 implementation; never feed this objective to the v3 annual-gap ranker.
zero_gap_policy: No formal normalization until M4 defines and tests a no-open-gap policy; never use annual gap as fallback.

selection.method: First ten agent IDs in ascending order; four source-linked policies and six source-linked clients per scenario, with stratified synthetic action contexts and explicit filter controls

horizon_target_source.rationale: Predetermined synthetic 30-day capacity plan: planned bound cases times planned case premium. Neither annual gaps, model weights, rankings nor evaluation results are inputs. These are assumptions, not company-approved targets.

horizon_current_source.crediting_rule: Count only confirmed written-premium credits dated within the horizon and recorded at or before the snapshot cutoff. This synthetic future-window ledger has no such records.
horizon_current_source.rationale: The horizon is wholly after the cutoff; no confirmed in-window credit exists in this synthetic ledger. Annual YTD and forecasts are not current horizon production.
